svg.aria-label: IndusTrust Bank: Spring Boot web bank with a double-entry ledger, atomic transfers and BigDecimal money. Pipeline: BUILD, HARDEN, DEPLOY, LIVE complete. Hardened with BCrypt passwords + PINs, row-level locks, per-user isolation. Stack: Spring Boot · PostgreSQL · Docker.
